experiences.name: Zermatt Ski Resort Full-Day Pass
experiences.description: Ski the world-famous slopes of Zermatt with a full-day lift pass covering over 360km of pistes. With the Matterhorn as your backdrop, enjoy runs for all skill levels. Book accommodation directly in Zermatt village to walk to the lifts and maximize slope time. Ideal from Day 2 onward given late Day 1 arrival — use Day 1 evening to settle in and rent gear locally.

experiences.name: Jungfrau Region Snowshoeing & Winter Hiking
experiences.description: Explore the stunning Jungfrau region on a guided snowshoe trek through pristine alpine landscapes. Trails depart directly from Grindelwald village, making it easy to access without long transfers. A perfect mid-week activity to complement ski days. Guides provide all equipment and lead groups through scenic routes with panoramic mountain views.
experiences.location: Grindelwald village, Bernese Oberland, Swiss Alps

experiences.name: Verbier Freeride & Off-Piste Ski Experience
experiences.description: Join a certified mountain guide for a half-day off-piste freeride session in Verbier, one of Europe's top freeride destinations. Stay in Verbier village to access the lifts on foot within minutes. This experience is best scheduled mid-trip when legs are warmed up. Includes avalanche safety briefing and beacon use.

experiences.name: Glacier 3000 Cable Car & Snow Bus Ride
experiences.description: Take the iconic cable car from Col du Pillon up to Glacier 3000 and experience the thrilling Snow Bus ride across the glacier plateau. Enjoy panoramic views of 24 peaks over 4000m. The base station is easily reachable from Les Diablerets village where staying locally cuts transfer time significantly. Best enjoyed on a clear afternoon after a morning ski session.
experiences.location: Les Diablerets, Vaud Alps, Swiss Alps

experiences.name: Davos Cross-Country Skiing & Nordic Trails
experiences.description: Glide through 75km of groomed Nordic trails in Davos, the highest town in the Alps. Cross-country skiing is a budget-friendly and scenic alternative to downhill days. Rent equipment directly in Davos Platz and access trails from the town center. A great option for Day 6 or 7 to wind down before departure while still enjoying the alpine scenery.
